task: Predict the presence of Barrett esophagus in esophageal carcinoma. Classes: No vs. Yes. On H&E, look for adjacent intestinal metaplasia with goblet cells and specialized columnar epithelium versus absence of this metaplastic background.

classes.0: No Barrett esophagus — no adjacent intestinal metaplasia or goblet cell-lined columnar mucosa is identified.
classes.1: Yes Barrett esophagus — adjacent Barrett mucosa with intestinal metaplasia and goblet cells is present.
